answers.reason: The senate is a central university body and the dean holds office below the central leadership level.
Budget planning touches university-wide funding plans, involving higher rank office holders.
Appointment decisions are part of the university-wide plan involving higher office holders.
The dean leads the faculty and chairs its council.
The study commission is a body of the faculty led by the dean.
The examination board belongs to the faculty where the dean holds the leading office.
The internal research funding round is a faculty matter falling under the dean's leadership.
Module revisions concern the faculty's study programmes overseen by the dean.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a faculty-level matter.
Orientation week planning is organized within the faculty.
